testCase:
T-10: Select rows, then a bulk action
Goal: Archive the invoices INV-1003, INV-1007 and INV-1012.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/t-10/
STEP 2: Check "INV-1003" and "INV-1007" on page 1
STEP 3: Click "Next" and check "INV-1012"
STEP 4: Click "Archive selected (3)"
STEP 5: Verify "Archived 3 invoices: INV-1003, INV-1007, INV-1012" is visible

steps.note: Open the invoice selection test page.
Verify the confirmation identifies all three archived invoices.

reasoning: This test checks that invoice selections persist across pagination and that a bulk action archives all three selected invoices. The plan follows the specified selection order and verifies the exact archive confirmation.
